A large unnamed settlement of [[Cantha]]ns lies near the center, south of [[Tomaat Pass]]. The [[Angchu]] village of [[Aerie]] is located here, as is a small camp of the [[Crimson Skull]] gang. Roving bands of [[Kappa]] and [[Naga]] make travel dangerous. {{TOCright}} ==Getting there== Exit from [[Ran Musu Gardens]] or travel west through [[Sunqua Vale]] or [[Panjiang Peninsula]].
